Mission Local reported that San Francisco State lecturers were told their classes would be cut back—sometimes entirely—starting in the spring. The story said lecturers made up about 60 percent of the university’s faculty and were facing the largest cuts, with most colleges seeing about a 30 percent decrease. The union said the cuts would affect several times more lecturers than the number of full-time positions because most lecturers work part-time.
